components.buttons: pill-shaped, high-contrast, slight scale on hover
components.cards: flat background, 1px subtle border, no initial shadow, shadow-lg on hover

grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6
grids.marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 or gap-12

layouts.container_padding: p-6 or p-8 for bordered containers

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard minimum, minimum 4.5:1 for normal text

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.
Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
Use Shadcn UI components for advanced interactions.
Ensure 100% white-label capability (no hardcoded tenant strings).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Add data-testid attribute to all interactive elements.
